description: Store and change a person's memory in OpenVibe.AI (Memory M2): POST /api/v1/memory/items:batch imports up to 200 items, PATCH /items/{id} changes text, kind, scope or status, DELETE /items/{id} and DELETE /items?source= remove rows. The person's own token or a service acting on_behalf_of them. Redaction runs again on the server (openvibe-sdk/redact), an item that is only a secret is refused, AI-produced items are suggestions until the person accepts them, and a delete removes the row (profiles that used it are rebuilt).
